about: Route bends through walkable space between consecutive stops (tools/route_paths.py). Moves and legs marked generated are redone by the tool; the others and the overrides are kept. The import block and the legs marked import come from an imported route (tools/import_routes.py); this tool computes only the legs that route does not cover.

import.from: Forever Dungeon Routes 1.2.4, route 'default' (WoW dungeon journal (boss positions), paths over the walkable floors in the game's files)
import.note: Route: Forever Dungeon Routes (MIT), by Checkov23.
